reusable.description: True when the agent accepts the invitation any number of times

shortUrl.description: The short URL of a standalone invitation, or null

parentConnectionId.description: The connection that carried a sub-connection invitation, or null for a standalone invitation

acceptances.description: The acceptances of the invitation, empty while the state is `created`

connectionId.description: The connection that the acceptance produced, or that the peer reused

reused.description: True when the peer accepted the invitation on a connection that it already held, false when the acceptance produced a new connection

acceptedAt.description: When the peer accepted the invitation

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page. The agent sets it to null on the last page.
